snippet.title: Off the Shelf! - Coming Soon
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3584250/Off_the_Shelf/

Off the Shelf! is a hilarious physics-based romp made for maximum chaos! Launch a free ragdoll character into a frantic rush, knocking objects off shelves to rack up points. Master the art of Shelf Surfing as you jump, dash, and smash your way to a high score!
